# Casho (كاشو)

> Casho (كاشو) is an online marketplace in Saudi Arabia where people and companies sell and buy items, cars and properties. It combines a shop, short videos (reels), live shows, auctions and item trades, with AI tools and safe payments. Casho holds the payment in escrow until the buyer receives the order, and eligible orders can be paid in installments with Tamara. Casho works in Arabic and English. The iPhone app is coming soon to the App Store (no store link or launch date yet); Android is planned next.

Brand name: Casho (English), كاشو (Arabic). Website: https://appcasho.com. Operated by Alkhazinah Alriyadiyah Company For Information Technology Shakhs Wahid (شركة الخزينة الريادية لتقنية المعلومات شخص واحد), Saudi Arabia. Contact: support@appcasho.com (reply within 2 business days).

## Key facts
- Delivery is inside Saudi Arabia only. Prices are in Saudi riyals (SAR).
- Payment is made inside the app by card or mada, or in installments with Tamara on eligible orders. Card details never reach the seller.
- Casho is not only live shopping: the Shop, reels, auctions and trades work at any time, without waiting for a live.
- Trades: a seller can propose to swap an item for another seller's item.
- AI features: smart search in Arabic and English, price suggestions, listing descriptions written for the seller, and photo safety checks.
- Casho holds the payment until the buyer receives the order and the 7-day report period ends.
- If a seller does not ship within 5 days of payment, the order is cancelled and the buyer is refunded in full.
- Individuals and companies can sell. New sellers are reviewed before they can go live.
